storage: Room temperature, tightly closed, away from heat and sunlight. Pour opened pouches into a clean, dry bottle. Use a dry spoon so water and food bits do not get in.

usedIn.raw: 5 ml (about 4.6 g; 1 tsp; "groundnut or coconut oil also used")
10 ml groundnut oil, with "sesame/gingelly oil or coconut oil also traditional"
"a few drops of sesame oil at the end", optional and not counted (and that would be the toasted kind)
